## Recall · Slides and notes

a) Which layout fits the first and the last slide of a talk?
b) Where do you write what you will say?
c) Which button gives every slide the same quiet transition?

::: {.answer}
a) Title Slide
b) in the speaker notes
c) Apply To All
:::

## Recall · A five-slide talk

a) Which slide comes right after the title?
b) Which slide gives a number or a case?
c) What does Presenter View show you?

::: {.answer}
a) the problem
b) the example
c) the slide, the next slide, the notes and a timer
:::

## Summary

- A short talk has five slides: title, problem, idea, example, thanks.
- The speaker notes hold what you say, in your own words.
- One quiet transition on every slide is enough.
- Presenter View shows you the notes and a timer, and the audience sees only the slide.
- You rehearse twice and keep each slide close to its plan.
